description: This file defines utility functions for initializing and checking the connection status of IARM, an inter-process communication bus system, encapsulated within the Utils namespace and IARM struct. It includes macros for handling IARM function call results and logs the outcomes of various operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the IARM bus connection if not already connected, with retries and logging.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the IARM bus is already connected.
